k34e26f4b: In 1830, the book was first published under the title “The Book of Mormon”
k62ddc82e: Today it has been translated into more than 100 languages and is one of the most widely distributed books in the world
k1348f944: The Book of Mormon teaches the gospel of Jesus Christ with extraordinary clarity. Some of its central themes include:
ke44d9875: The nature of God and of Jesus Christ
kbb55d3e7: Faith, repentance, baptism and the gift of the Holy Ghost
k6b0b3b37: The visit of the resurrected Jesus Christ to the American continent
k9a08ceb4: Pride as the cause of the fall of civilizations — and humility as the path to prosperity
k386ee6f1: The promise that anyone who reads it sincerely can know, by the Holy Ghost, that it is true
k27ea01b4: How can I know if it is true?
k2ed23f30: The book itself invites the reader to test its truthfulness. In Moroni 10:3-5, it promises that anyone who reads the book, reflects on its contents and asks God in sincere prayer whether it is true will receive an answer through the power of the Holy Ghost.
k8d370098: This invitation has been accepted by millions of people around the world, who testify that they have received that spiritual confirmation. Would you like to try it too?
k3b3155ec: We can send or personally deliver a Book of Mormon to you completely free, with no obligation.

k72bf8226: Talk to God. He listens to you and wants to answer your questions.
k585a4ddf: Prayer is the way we communicate with God, our Heavenly Father. It is not a complicated ritual and it doesn't require special words — it is simply talking to Him as you would talk to a loving father who knows you and cares about you.
kcd709f1b: God wants to hear from you. He wants to hear your joys, your worries, your questions and your thanks. And most importantly: He answers.
kd1a9ec5b: There is no wrong way to pray if you do it sincerely. However, Jesus Christ taught us a simple pattern:
k7ccc9527: <t1>Address God:</t1> Begin by saying “Heavenly Father” or “Dear God”
k8f28eb85: <t1>Give thanks:</t1> Express gratitude for the blessings you have received
k143a17a1: <t1>Ask:</t1> Share your needs, questions and desires with Him
ka2bb58d7: <t1>Close:</t1> End with “in the name of Jesus Christ, amen”
k3ec2ee43: Yes. God answers prayers, though not always in the way we expect. Sometimes the answer comes as a feeling of peace, a clear idea, the words of another person or a door that opens (or closes) in your life.
k813146c4: Learning to recognize God's answers is part of the path of faith. We invite you to try it — pray sincerely and watch what happens in your heart.
k857d646e: Millions of people around the world have experienced the power of prayer. It is not magic — it is a real relationship with a real God who loves you. Prayer gives you strength, direction and peace in the middle of life's storms.
ka12288bd: If you have never prayed, or if you want to deepen your relationship with God, we are here to help.
k9a53345f: Where do we come from? Why are we here? What will happen after this life?
k755cd027: Where do I come from? What is the purpose of this life? Is there anything after death? These questions have accompanied humankind from the beginning. For The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, the restored gospel offers clear, coherent answers full of hope.
kbfd5e725: Where do we come from? — Premortal life
k16416916: Before being born on this earth, we existed as spirits in the presence of God. We were His spirit sons and daughters. We lived, learned and grew. There we were presented with the Plan of Salvation — the opportunity to come to earth, receive a physical body, be tested and progress toward a fulness of joy that was not possible in our spiritual state.
k7aeee6fd: This truth changes everything: we are not human beings having a spiritual experience, but spiritual beings having a human experience. We come from somewhere, we have a noble origin and a Father who knows and loves us individually.
k80fa9fcf: Why are we here? — The purpose of mortal life
k5b7b098f: Receive a physical body — an essential part of our eternal progress
k7518005e: Be tested and show whether we will keep God's commandments
kf23f9d2a: Learn from our own experience the difference between good and evil
k642b6ba4: Make sacred covenants with God, including baptism
k4037d607: Form families and learn to love and serve others
ke1c1fb27: Forgetting our premortal life is not a punishment — it is necessary for the test of mortality to be real. If we remembered everything, there would be no true faith.
k48afd3ce: What will happen after this life?
k44fac144: After death, our spirit goes to the spirit world — an intermediate state where we await the resurrection. There is opportunity there to keep learning and to hear the gospel, especially for those who did not have the opportunity in this life.
k8f37fd5d: After the resurrection and the final judgment, we will all receive one of the kingdoms of glory that God has prepared:
k3be1b5e3: <t1>The celestial glory</t1> — the highest, where those who accepted the full gospel and lived its principles will dwell. Here one can be in the presence of God and Christ
ke768075c: <t1>The terrestrial glory</t1> — for those who were honorable people but rejected the full gospel
k9f16e308: <t1>The telestial glory</t1> — for those who did not accept the gospel and persisted in evil
k1eca4230: In all of these kingdoms there is mercy. God is just and knows the heart of every person. His aim is the happiness of His children — not their condemnation.
k34d97af6: The resurrection and the eternal body
kbac6bbe2: Thanks to the Atonement of Jesus Christ, we will all be resurrected. Our bodies and spirits will be permanently united in a glorified state. Death is not the end — it is a transition. For those who have lived the gospel, it is a welcome into something much greater.
kb5dcce73: Do you have questions about eternal life?
kb5ccb27e: We would love to talk with you about the Plan of Salvation and what it means for your life here and now.
k862078bc: Why are we here? Where do we come from? Where are we going?
kcffa6c36: At some point, we have all wondered why we exist. Is there a purpose behind it all? Is this life just chance, or is there a greater plan?
k1c327307: We believe life has a deep and beautiful purpose. God, our Heavenly Father, has a plan for each of His children — a plan of happiness.
kaf343e80: Before we were born, we lived with God as His spirit children. He loved us and wanted us to grow, learn and become like Him. For that, He created a plan:
k05599488: <t1>Premortal life:</t1> We lived with God before we were born. There we chose to come to earth to obtain a body and learn from our own experience.
kd2ca711e: <t1>Earth life:</t1> This life is a school. Here we learn to tell good from evil, to love, to serve and to develop faith.
ke0b95fdb: <t1>Life after death:</t1> Death is not the end. Thanks to Jesus Christ, we will all be resurrected and be able to live with God again.
kfdae3109: One of the hardest questions is why we suffer. If God loves us, why does He allow pain? We believe difficulties are an essential part of our growth. Just as a child needs to fall in order to learn to walk, we need to face challenges in order to grow spiritually.
k0f6eff1d: But we are not alone. Jesus Christ experienced all of our pain so that He could comfort and help us. He understands perfectly what you feel.
k532a73be: You are not an accident. You are a son or daughter of God, with divine potential. Your life has a specific purpose, and God knows you personally — your dreams, your fears, your hopes.
k54a9844f: Talk to us about the plan God has for you. We are here to walk with you.
kde3b8f16: The Purpose of Life — Busca Cristo
k1fa58dee: The gospel of Jesus Christ was restored to the earth. Find out how and why.
k61f4e6df: After Jesus Christ established His Church and ascended to heaven, His apostles were persecuted and killed one by one. With their deaths, the authority of the priesthood — the power to act in God's name — was lost from the earth. This period is known as the Great Apostasy.
kab35693c: For centuries, many truths of the gospel were lost or changed. People sought God sincerely, but did not have access to the fulness of the gospel that Jesus Christ had taught. God, in His love for His children, prepared the time to restore everything that had been lost.
kb519c8e2: In the spring of 1820, a 14-year-old boy named Joseph Smith had questions about which church was true. Influenced by James 1:5, he decided to pray and ask God directly. While praying in a grove in New York, he had a vision in which God the Father and Jesus Christ appeared to him.
k2893c1ea: This event, known as the First Vision, marked the beginning of the Restoration of the gospel. God had spoken to man again.
kaa0373d5: The Restoration of the priesthood and the Church
k27217db0: John the Baptist restored the Aaronic Priesthood to Joseph Smith in 1829
k212f6313: Peter, James and John restored the Melchizedek Priesthood shortly afterward
k8a45d606: On April 6, 1830, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints was formally organized
k095b720b: The Book of Mormon was published as an additional testament of Jesus Christ
kc0630489: The same organization that Jesus established — with apostles and prophets — was restored
k31e9edb2: What does this mean for you?
k995f212d: The Restoration is not just history — it has deep implications for every person today. It means that the fulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ is available again: the authority of the priesthood, sacred covenants, saving ordinances and the guidance of living prophets and apostles.
kd00b7f53: If you have questions about Joseph Smith, the First Vision or the origin of the Church, we would love to talk with you without any pressure.
k1e7d3642: Talk to us. We will share the message of the Restoration with you with love and respect.
k2d63afed: Sacred places where families can be united forever and make covenants with God.
